name: Hood Packaging Corporation
old_description: For 60 years we’ve been a leading North American manufacturer of industrial plastic and paper packaging.
about:
Hood Packaging Corporation is headquartered in Arden Hills, Minnesota. The company states it has operated for 60 years as a North American manufacturer of industrial plastic and paper packaging. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.

They produce industrial plastic and paper packaging. Operations include extrusion, printing, and converting, as indicated by job postings for extrusion operators, printing & converting supervisors, and maintenance technicians at their Tyler, Texas plant. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

The company describes its customers as major manufacturers across multiple markets, though specific industries or client names are not provided.

The careers page emphasizes employee-focused values—above-average pay, low-cost benefits, career advancement, and a personal atmosphere—but does not articulate a founding mission or manufacturing differentiator.
built_on: Career advancement and continued education opportunities
